title: One connector's declaration
description: What connectors/<name>.yml holds in a directory that `ingestion connectors apply` sends, and each entry of an applied set's connectors. A poll or a folder runs on its schedule. A drop or a push runs as its items arrive, and is due its due_interval after its last delivery.

name.description: The connector's name, which its file is named for.

source.description: The external feed the connector reads, by its name in the data catalog. A source with a drop handler of its own splits each dropped file into items.

contract.description: The contract the source's payloads hold to.

schedule.description: A poll's or a folder's schedule: five cron fields, a descriptor such as @hourly, or @every 15m, read in UTC unless a CRON_TZ=<zone> prefix names another zone.

due_interval.description: How long after its last delivery a drop or a push is due again, as a count of m, h, d or w, such as 30d.

freshness.description: How long a poll or a folder may go without a delivery before it reads overdue, in due_interval's form.

tags.description: The tags every item the connector lands carries on its sighting.

zone.description: Who writes the content the connector carries, as its items' default: outside for an outsider, owner for the owner.

read_rule.description: How an item the connector landed is read where no tag's rule decides: as-is, or a model read. Left out, the side's default decides.

root.description: The [serve.homes] root a folder connector reads.

path.description: The directory below the root a folder connector reads, with forward slashes. Left out, it reads the whole root.
